hooks.name: Pre-commit secret scan
hooks.description: Before a git commit (detected via PreToolUse on the shell tool when the command contains 'git commit'), scan staged files for real 12-digit AWS account IDs (allow 111122223333), AKIA access keys, and ARNs with real account IDs. Exit 2 blocks the commit. Read-only: never modifies files.

action.command:
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" || exit 0
INPUT=$(cat)
IS_COMMIT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | .venv/bin/python3.12 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); s=json.dumps(d); print('1' if 'git commit' in s else '0')" 2>/dev/null) || IS_COMMIT=0
[ "$IS_COMMIT" != "1" ] && exit 0
.venv/bin/python3.12 - <<'PYEOF'
import subprocess, sys, re
result = subprocess.run(["git","diff","--cached","--name-only"], capture_output=True, text=True)
staged = result.stdout.strip().splitlines()
REAL_ACCOUNT_RE = re.compile(r'\b(?!111122223333)\d{12}\b')
ACCESS_KEY_RE = re.compile(r'\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b')
ARN_REAL_RE = re.compile(r'arn:aws:[^:]+:[^:]*:(?!111122223333)\d{12}:')
violations = []
for path in staged:
    try:
        content = open(path).read()
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        continue
    for pattern, label in [(REAL_ACCOUNT_RE,"real account ID"),(ACCESS_KEY_RE,"AWS access key"),(ARN_REAL_RE,"ARN with real account ID")]:
        for m in pattern.finditer(content):
            violations.append(f"{path}: possible {label}: {m.group()!r}")
if violations:
    print("BLOCKED: Possible secrets or real account IDs detected:")
    for v in violations: print(" ", v)
    sys.exit(2)
print("Secret scan clean. No real account IDs or keys in staged files.")
PYEOF
